mentions.h: 1924 CAN YOU NAME THE BLANKS? / 1933 BEIGRAVE WALKERS AND THE R.W.A. 'GARNET' CUP
FROM 'THE BELGRAVIAN' 25 years ago ...... and 40 years ago
WELCOME TO THE FOLLOWING NEW MEMBERS

mentions.note: joined in the late twenties, regular member of walking teams; rejoined as Hon. Member; spectator at Club 20 miles walking championship
contributor to the John Bicourt fund
donor towards new tables and chairs at Belgrave Hall
member who used the old Battersea Park track (three laps to the mile); address given as Basingstoke
1938 National Junior 10 Miles walk winning team
R.F. Elson, walker; died aged 78; 7th in 1938 R.W.A. National Junior Championship at Golders Green, 4th scorer in winning Belgrave team
